text:
I follow you, with the nostalgia of centuries

that were not and will not be mine...

Not to have an unending age in which to love you!

To remain on your shore as on that of a young man

who runs toward his limits, my limited today.


I did not have nor will I have an eternity of you.

I am one minute of yours, and that hurts me so much

that I suffer in loving you, and would give you

more earth of myself, while keeping you in me.


Yes. I contemplate and hear you. I smell your seed

and, poor Sarah that I am, I do not return to you

what you come to give me.




The Poems of Mar Menor, 1959

translation.title: Verification
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the limited minute of eternity and the Sarah allusion of unreturned fertility.
